items.label: FAKE
items.title: Quantum Locking Floating Magnet Room-Temperature Antigravity Startup Scam
items.text: Viral social media videos claim a tech startup created room-temperature antigravity floating magnets for flying cars and commercial hoverboards. In reality, quantum locking flux pinning requires sub-zero liquid nitrogen temperatures and superconductors.

items.label: FAKE
items.title: Leaked Military TR-3B UFO Magnetic Field Disruptor Neutralizes Mass
items.text: Conspiracy sites claim the US military built a secret triangular craft TR-3B utilizing magnetic field disruptors to eliminate 89% of vehicle mass and achieve gravity-defying propulsion.

items.label: FAKE
items.title: Flat Earth Geodesy Conspiracy: Planet is an Enclosed Stationary Plane
items.text: Claims allege that NASA and world governments conceal the flat plane nature of the Earth and that Antarctica is a giant ice wall encircling the world.

items.label: FAKE
items.title: 5G Cellular Radiation Causes Viral Pandemic Outbreak
items.text: Viral posts falsely claim 5G wireless millimeter towers transmit biological viruses and suppress human immune systems.

items.label: FAKE
items.title: Secret Lemon and Baking Soda Mixture Cures All Forms of Cancer
items.text: Social media chains claim alkaline lemon juice and baking soda is 10,000 times stronger than chemotherapy and eliminates all cancer tumors within days.

items.label: FAKE
items.title: Indian Currency Notes Contain Radioactive GPS Tracking Nano-Chips
items.text: Viral rumors claim new bank currency notes are embedded with satellite nano-trackers capable of transmitting coordinates from subterranean lockers.

items.label: REAL
items.title: NASA Satellite Data and Geodesy Confirm Earth is an Oblate Spheroid
items.text: Astronomical measurements, satellite photography, and gravitational geodetic surveys empirically verify that Earth is approximately spherical with an equatorial bulge.

items.label: REAL
items.title: BCCI Announces India Squad Leadership Transition: Shreyas Iyer Appointed Captain
items.text: The Board of Control for Cricket in India selection committee officially confirmed Shreyas Iyer as the new T20I captain, succeeding Suryakumar Yadav.

items.label: REAL
items.title: United Nations Demographic Data: Asia is Largest Continent by Land and Population
items.text: Official geographic and demographic surveys confirm Asia constitutes the largest continent by geographic land area and total human population.

items.label: REAL
items.title: Reserve Bank of India Monetary Policy Committee Keeps Repo Rate Unchanged
items.text: The Reserve Bank of India announced its bi-monthly monetary policy decision maintaining benchmark lending repo rates following inflation assessments.

items.label: REAL
items.title: ISRO Successfully Launches Advanced Ocean Monitoring Satellite into Polar Orbit
items.text: The Indian Space Research Organisation successfully placed its latest earth observation oceanography satellite into Sun-synchronous polar orbit.

items.label: REAL
items.title: Bollywood Actor Salman Khan Maintains Bachelor Status; Unmarried
items.text: Biographical records and official statements confirm Bollywood superstar Salman Khan remains unmarried throughout his cinema career.

items.label: REAL
items.title: Spain Wins 2026 FIFA World Cup Final Defeating Argentina
items.text: Spain claimed the 2026 FIFA World Cup championship after a 1-0 victory in the final match held in North America.

items.label: FAKE
items.title: India Wins 2026 FIFA World Cup Football Championship Final
items.text: Fabricated social media posts claim the Indian national football team won the FIFA World Cup tournament final.

items.label: FAKE
items.title: WHO Declares Drinking Boiled Garlic Water Completely Prevents Respiratory Viruses
items.text: False health alerts claim consuming boiled garlic water guarantees complete immunity against respiratory pathogen infections.

items.label: REAL
items.title: Russia-Ukraine war remains an active ongoing military conflict along the eastern frontline.
items.text: As confirmed by Reuters, AP News, and the Institute for the Study of War (ISW), the Russia-Ukraine armed conflict is ongoing with active combat operations in the Donbas, Kharkiv, and southern sectors without a comprehensive ceasefire.

items.label: FAKE
items.title: Russia and Ukraine signed a permanent peace agreement ending all war hostilities.
items.text: Viral social media posts claimed that a permanent peace treaty was signed in Geneva officially ending all hostilities between Russia and Ukraine. | Debunked: No permanent peace treaty or ceasefire has been ratified; diplomatic negotiations remain stalled.

items.label: REAL
items.title: Russian military forces maintain operational control over Crimea and parts of eastern Ukraine.
items.text: Official military updates and satellite reconnaissance confirm Russian armed forces maintain territorial control over the Crimean peninsula, Luhansk, Donetsk, and portions of Zaporizhzhia and Kherson oblasts.

items.label: FAKE
items.title: Russia completed a full military withdrawal of all armed forces from Ukrainian territory.
items.text: Claims circulated alleging Russian military units had fully withdrawn to pre-2014 borders. | Debunked: Frontline monitoring confirms continuous Russian military deployment and combat operations in occupied territories.

items.label: REAL
items.title: Gen Z-led nationwide protests in Kenya forced the government to withdraw the 2024 Finance Bill.
items.text: Reporting by Al Jazeera, BBC, and The Daily Nation confirmed that youth-led Gen Z demonstrations against proposed tax hikes across Nairobi and major Kenyan cities compelled President William Ruto to decline signing the Finance Bill 2024.

items.label: FAKE
items.title: Kenya Finance Bill 2024 was signed into law without amendments during Gen Z protests.
items.text: Online misinformation asserted that the controversial tax bill was enacted unchanged despite street demonstrations. | Debunked: President William Ruto officially announced the total withdrawal and rejection of the Finance Bill on national television.

items.label: REAL
items.title: Student quota reform demonstrations in Bangladesh led to the resignation and departure of Sheikh Hasina.
items.text: International wire reports from Reuters, The Hindu, and AP News verified that weeks of student-led quota movement protests culminated in Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina resigning on August 5, 2024, and the formation of an interim government led by Muhammad Yunus.

items.label: FAKE
items.title: Sheikh Hasina remains the active, serving Prime Minister of Bangladesh in Dhaka.
items.text: Unverified claims suggested that the Bangladesh prime minister had not resigned and continued governing from the Prime Minister's Office. | Debunked: Sheikh Hasina submitted her formal resignation to the President and departed to India; an interim administration assumed executive powers.

items.label: REAL
items.title: Ram Mandir is located in Ayodhya, Uttar Pradesh, constructed under the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust.
items.text: Government gazettes, Supreme Court records, and verified reporting from The Hindu and PTI confirm that the Ram Janmabhoomi temple is located in Ayodhya, Uttar Pradesh, India, with the consecration ceremony held in January 2024.

items.label: FAKE
items.title: The newly constructed Ram Mandir is located in Pakistan or disputed foreign territory.
items.text: Fabricated claims circulated asserting that the Ram Janmabhoomi temple was built outside Indian sovereign territory. | Debunked: Verified geographic coordinates (26.7956° N, 82.1943° E) and state administration confirm location in Ayodhya, Uttar Pradesh, India.

items.label: REAL
items.title: Audited financial accounts and land purchases for Ram Mandir were submitted to statutory authorities.
items.text: Fact-checks by BOOM Live, Vishvas News, and PTI audited allegations regarding Ayodhya land registry transactions, confirming market valuation registries and banking transfer records through transparent statutory trusts.

items.label: FAKE
items.title: Viral claims alleging 1000 crore cash scam in Ram Mandir donation gold accounts without bank audit.
items.text: Viral WhatsApp forwards claimed that all public temple donations were embezzled without ledger records or banking receipts. | Debunked: The Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Trust and Chartered Accountant audit reports confirmed all donations are digitally audited under SBI/PNB accounts with 80G tax exemptions.

items.label: REAL
items.title: Narendra Modi is the serving Prime Minister of India heading the NDA Union Cabinet.
items.text: Official press releases from the Press Information Bureau (PIB) and President's Secretariat confirm Narendra Modi was sworn in as the Prime Minister of India following the June 2024 general election results.

items.label: FAKE
items.title: Rahul Gandhi or opposition leader was sworn in as Prime Minister of India in 2024.
items.text: Misleading election victory graphics claimed that an opposition leader was sworn in as the 15th Prime Minister of India. | Debunked: Official oath of office was administered to Prime Minister Narendra Modi at Rashtrapati Bhavan on June 9, 2024.

items.label: REAL
items.title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY) provides subsidized housing assistance to eligible urban and rural beneficiaries.
items.text: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs documentation verifies the government approved the construction of over 3 crore additional rural and urban housing units under PMAY-Urban and PMAY-Gramin expansions.

items.label: FAKE
items.title: Government announced direct transfer of Rs 5 lakh cash to every citizen bank account under housing scheme.
items.text: Viral phishing messages claimed that the Union Government is depositing 5 lakh cash directly into all bank accounts without application. | Debunked: PIB Fact Check confirmed PMAY provides targeted interest subsidies and staged construction disbursements directly to verified geo-tagged houses, not unconditional cash transfers.

items.label: REAL
items.title: India won the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2024 by defeating South Africa in the final at Barbados.
items.text: Official ICC tournament records, BCCI match reports, and global coverage from ESPNcricinfo and Reuters confirm India defeated South Africa by 7 runs in Bridgetown, Barbados on June 29, 2024.

items.label: FAKE
items.title: South Africa won the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2024 final against India.
items.text: Inverted match result posts claimed South Africa lifted the T20 World Cup 2024 trophy. | Debunked: India successfully defended 176 runs to win the final by 7 runs, clinching their second T20 World Cup title.

items.label: REAL
items.title: Kolkata Knight Riders (KKR) won the 2024 Indian Premier League (IPL) title.
items.text: IPL official records and sports news reports from ESPNcricinfo and Indian Express verify KKR defeated Sunrisers Hyderabad in the final at MA Chidambaram Stadium, Chennai.

items.label: FAKE
items.title: Chennai Super Kings (CSK) or Royal Challengers Bengaluru won the IPL 2024 championship.
items.text: Misleading fan posts circulated claiming CSK won their sixth IPL title in 2024. | Debunked: KKR won the 2024 championship final by 8 wickets, securing their third IPL franchise title.
